--!strict
-- Plays and blends the walk of SkinnedRigs.gltf from input, with root motion Apply (Animation.replay, M23;
-- Docs/Decisions/0034-m23-contract.md decision 33): Jump restarts the walk on layer 1 and starts the Animator's layers;
-- MoveX fades in a second walk layer, half a cycle ahead, by its magnitude. Without input the Walker stands still.
export type Director = ScriptInstance & {
	Walk: AssetRef?,
	Starts: number,
}

local Director = {}

Director.Fields = {
	Walk = Field.Asset("AnimationClip"),
}

function Director.OnCreate(self: Director)
	self.Starts = 0
end

function Director.OnFixedUpdate(self: Director, dt: number)
	local animator = self.Entity.Animator
	local walk = self.Walk
	if animator == nil or walk == nil then
		return
	end
	if Input.IsActionPressed("Jump") then
		self.Starts += 1
		animator:Play(1, walk, 0)
		animator.Playing = true
	end
	local blend = math.clamp(math.abs(Input.GetAxis("MoveX")), 0, 1)
	if blend > 0 and #animator.Layers < 2 then
		animator:Play(2, walk, 0.5)
	end
	if #animator.Layers >= 2 then
		animator:SetWeight(2, blend)
	end
end

return Script.Define("Director", Director)

--!strict
-- Shared helpers of the animation suites (Animation.scene; M23, Docs/Decisions/0034-m23-contract.md decision 33).
local Animation = {}

-- The Wave clip of Skinned.gltf (one second; the import settings' events Start, Peak and End) and the Walk clip of
-- SkinnedRigs.gltf (one second; its hips move 1 m along the rig's +Z).
Animation.WAVE = "Assets/Models/Animation/Skinned.gltf#animation:0:Wave"
Animation.WALK = "Assets/Models/Animation/SkinnedRigs.gltf#animation:0:Walk"

-- The entity at `path` in the running scene; a missing one fails the calling case.
function Animation.Find(path: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByPath(path)
	if entity == nil then
		error(path .. " is not in the scene", 2)
	end
	return entity
end

-- The Animator of the entity at `path`.
function Animation.Animator(path: string): Animator
	local animator = Animation.Find(path).Animator
	if animator == nil then
		error(path .. " has no Animator", 2)
	end
	return animator
end

-- The asset at `reference`, which must load.
function Animation.Load(reference: string): AssetRef
	local asset = Assets.Load(reference)
	if asset == nil then
		error(reference .. " does not load", 2)
	end
	return asset
end

return Animation

--!strict
-- Skeletal and morph animation in every run mode (M23 W23.3; Docs/Decisions/0034-m23-contract.md decisions 25 to 33;
-- Animation.jsonl, IdSeed 2107): Animation.scene holds three imported rigs. The Waver (Skinned.gltf) plays the Wave clip
-- on two layers with RootMotion Extract and an EventProbe behaviour; the Statue (Skinned.gltf) has no layer and a morph
-- weight; the Walker's Character (SkinnedRigs.gltf) stands with Playing false and RootMotion Apply until its Director
-- behaviour or a case starts it. The pose digest is committed from the Editor run, so the exported Release and Dist runs
-- prove that a sampled pose hashes equal in every configuration (Roadmap M23).
local Animation = require("./Animation")
local EventProbeScript = require("../../Scripts/Animation/EventProbe")

-- Test.GetPoseDigest after the case below waits its ticks, committed from the Editor run.
local WAVER_DIGEST = "3ce4af55e765a3aa"
local STATUE_DIGEST = "822af7e0482d6a11"

return Test.Suite("Animation", function()
	Test.Case("the scene holds its Animators and SkinnedMeshes as authored", function()
		local wave = Animation.Load(Animation.WAVE)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetType(wave), "AnimationClip")
		local waver = Animation.Animator("/Waver/Armature")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetType(waver.Skeleton :: AssetRef), "Skeleton")
		Test.ExpectEqual(waver.RootMotion, "Extract")
		Test.ExpectEqual(waver.Playing, true)
		local layers = waver.Layers
		Test.ExpectEqual(#layers, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[1].Clip, wave)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[2].Clip, wave)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[2].Speed, 0.5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[2].Weight, 0.5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[2].Loop, false)
		local statue = Animation.Animator("/Statue/Armature")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#statue.Layers, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(statue.RootMotion, "None")
		local weights = (Animation.Find("/Statue/Armature/Body").SkinnedMesh :: SkinnedMesh).MorphWeights
		Test.ExpectEqual(#weights, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(weights[1], 0.75)
		local walker = Animation.Animator("/Walker/Character")
		Test.ExpectEqual(walker.Playing, false)
		Test.ExpectEqual(walker.RootMotion, "Apply")
		Test.ExpectEqual(walker.Layers[1].Clip, Animation.Load(Animation.WALK))
	end)

	Test.Case("a sampled pose hashes to its committed digest in every run mode", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(40)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Test.GetPoseDigest(Animation.Find("/Waver/Armature")), WAVER_DIGEST)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Test.GetPoseDigest(Animation.Find("/Statue/Armature")), STATUE_DIGEST)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Test.GetPoseDigest(Animation.Find("/Floor")), nil, "an entity without an Animator has no pose")
	end)

	Test.Case("events reach OnAnimationEvent in tick, layer and clip order", function()
		local probe = Animation.Find("/Waver/Armature"):GetScript("EventProbe") :: EventProbeScript.EventProbe
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return probe.Count >= 6
		end, 240)
		local wave = Animation.Load(Animation.WAVE)
		-- Layer 1 loops from 0 at speed 1; layer 2 holds its end, from 0.25 at speed 0.5: both pass Peak in tick 33, and
		-- layer 1's End fires before its next Start.
		local expected: { { Name: string, Layer: number, Time: number } } = {
			{ Name = "Start", Layer = 1, Time = 0 },
			{ Name = "Peak", Layer = 1, Time = 0.5 },
			{ Name = "Peak", Layer = 2, Time = 0.5 },
			{ Name = "End", Layer = 1, Time = 1 },
			{ Name = "Start", Layer = 1, Time = 0 },
			{ Name = "End", Layer = 2, Time = 1 },
		}
		for index, entry in expected do
			local event = probe.Events[index]
			Test.ExpectEqual(event.Name, entry.Name, `event {index}'s name`)
			Test.ExpectEqual(event.Layer, entry.Layer, `event {index}'s layer`)
			Test.ExpectNear(event.Time, entry.Time, 1e-6, `event {index}'s time`)
			Test.ExpectEqual(event.Clip, wave, `event {index}'s clip`)
		end
	end)

	Test.Case("root motion Apply moves the entity, Extract only reports it and None keeps it in the pose", function()
		local character = Animation.Find("/Walker/Character")
		local walker = Animation.Animator("/Walker/Character")
		local transform = character.Transform :: Transform
		local start = transform.Translation
		walker.Playing = true
		Test.WaitTicks(32)
		local moved = transform.Translation - start
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(vector.create(moved.x, 0, moved.z)) > 0.3, `Apply moved the Walker ({moved})`)
		Test.ExpectNear(moved.y, 0, 1e-4, "root motion is planar")
		local motion, turn = walker:GetRootMotion()
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(motion) > 0, "Apply reports the step's motion")
		Test.ExpectNear(turn.w, 1, 1e-4, "the walk does not turn")

		walker.RootMotion = "Extract"
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local held = transform.Translation
		Test.WaitTicks(8)
		Test.ExpectEqual(transform.Translation, held, "Extract leaves the Transform")
		motion = walker:GetRootMotion()
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(motion) > 0, "Extract reports the step's motion")

		walker.RootMotion = "None"
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		motion, turn = walker:GetRootMotion()
		Test.ExpectEqual(motion, vector.zero, "None reports no motion")
		Test.ExpectEqual(turn.w, 1, "and no turn")
		Test.ExpectEqual(transform.Translation, held, "None leaves the Transform")
	end)

	Test.Case("the posed and morphed meshes render", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.Screenshot("Animation")
		local minimum, maximum = Animation.Find("/Waver/Armature/Body"):GetWorldBounds()
		Test.Expect(minimum ~= nil and maximum ~= nil, "a skinned mesh has render bounds")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The Animator proxy (M23; Docs/Decisions/0034-m23-contract.md decision 31) in Animation.scene: Play, SetWeight,
-- GetJointTransform and GetRootMotion, and every field read and written.
local Animation = require("../Animation/Animation")
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.Animator", function()
	Test.Case("Play and SetWeight drive the layers, and refuse what the Animator lacks", function()
		local animator = Animation.Animator("/Statue/Armature")
		local wave = Animation.Load(Animation.WAVE)
		Test.ExpectEqual(#animator.Layers, 0)
		animator:Play(1, wave, 0.25)
		Test.ExpectEqual(#animator.Layers, 1, "the next index appends a layer")
		local first = animator.Layers[1]
		Test.ExpectEqual(first.Clip, wave)
		Test.ExpectEqual(first.Time, 0.25)
		Test.ExpectEqual(first.Speed, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(first.Weight, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(first.Loop, true)
		animator:Play(2, wave)
		Test.ExpectEqual(animator.Layers[2].Time, 0, "an absent time starts the clip")
		animator:SetWeight(2, 0.5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(animator.Layers[2].Weight, 0.5)
		animator:Play(1, nil)
		Test.ExpectEqual(animator.Layers[1].Clip, nil, "a nil clip clears the layer")
		Test.ExpectEqual(animator.Layers[1].Weight, 1, "Play keeps the weight")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			animator:Play(4, wave)
		end), "a layer past the next one raises")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			animator:Play(1, wave, -1)
		end), "a negative time raises")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			animator:SetWeight(3, 0.5)
		end), "a layer the Animator lacks raises")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			animator:SetWeight(1, 1.5)
		end), "a weight above 1 raises")
		for layer = 3, 8 do
			animator:Play(layer, wave)
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(#animator.Layers, 8)
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			animator:Play(9, wave)
		end), "a ninth layer raises")
	end)

	Test.Case("GetJointTransform and GetRootMotion read the last step's pose", function()
		local animator = Animation.Animator("/Waver/Armature")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local position, rotation = animator:GetJointTransform("Joint1")
		Test.Expect(position ~= nil and rotation ~= nil, "the skeleton has Joint1")
		local armature = (Animation.Find("/Waver/Armature").Transform :: Transform).WorldPosition
		Test.ExpectNear((position :: vector).y - armature.y, 1, 1e-4, "Joint1 sits a metre above the chain's root")
		local missing, none = animator:GetJointTransform("NoSuchJoint")
		Test.ExpectEqual(missing, nil)
		Test.ExpectEqual(none, nil)
		local motion, turn = Animation.Animator("/Statue/Armature"):GetRootMotion()
		Test.ExpectEqual(motion, vector.zero, "RootMotion None reports no motion")
		Support.ExpectQuatNear(turn, Quat.Identity(), 1e-6, "and no turn")
	end)

	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy", function()
		local animator = Animation.Animator("/Waver/Armature")
		local skeleton = animator.Skeleton
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(animator, "Skeleton", nil), skeleton, "the imported skeleton")
		animator.Skeleton = skeleton
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(animator, "Playing", false), true)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(animator, "RootMotion", "Apply"), "Extract")
		Support.RoundTrip(animator, "RootMotion", "None")
		local wave = Animation.Load(Animation.WAVE)
		animator.Layers = { { Clip = wave, Time = 0.5, Speed = 2, Weight = 0.25, Loop = false } }
		local layers = animator.Layers
		Test.ExpectEqual(#layers, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[1].Clip, wave)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[1].Time, 0.5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[1].Speed, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[1].Weight, 0.25)
		Test.ExpectEqual(layers[1].Loop, false)
		animator.Layers = {}
		Test.ExpectEqual(#animator.Layers, 0)
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The SkinnedMesh proxy (M23; Docs/Decisions/0034-m23-contract.md decision 31) in Animation.scene: MorphWeights read
-- and written, and SetMorphWeight by the morph target's name (Skinned.gltf's one target, Bulge).
local Animation = require("../Animation/Animation")

return Test.Suite("Api.SkinnedMesh", function()
	Test.Case("SetMorphWeight sets a target's weight by name and refuses what the mesh lacks", function()
		local skinned = Animation.Find("/Waver/Armature/Body").SkinnedMesh :: SkinnedMesh
		skinned:SetMorphWeight("Bulge", 0.5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(skinned.MorphWeights[1], 0.5)
		skinned:SetMorphWeight("Bulge", -1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(skinned.MorphWeights[1], -1)
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			skinned:SetMorphWeight("NoSuchTarget", 0.5)
		end), "a target the mesh lacks raises")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			skinned:SetMorphWeight("Bulge", 1.5)
		end), "a weight above 1 raises")
	end)

	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy", function()
		local skinned = Animation.Find("/Statue/Armature/Body").SkinnedMesh :: SkinnedMesh
		local before = skinned.MorphWeights
		Test.ExpectEqual(#before, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(before[1], 0.75)
		skinned.MorphWeights = { -0.25 }
		Test.ExpectEqual(#skinned.MorphWeights, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(skinned.MorphWeights[1], -0.25)
		skinned.MorphWeights = {}
		Test.ExpectEqual(#skinned.MorphWeights, 0)
	end)
end)
